_source: Joint geometry for library/joints.py (#54), kept beside standard_parts.json so the demo snapshot that pins that file is untouched. Each joint names its fit class; the per-side clearance itself comes from library/printer_profiles.py for the project's material, never from here. Every value is an uncalibrated starting value: a joint stays at the needs-physical-test tier until a print result is recorded.

_intent.fit: fit class whose clearance surrounds the peg in its socket
_intent.peg_dia: split peg diameter at the neck
_intent.barb: radial height of the barb; must exceed the clearance or the peg does not retain. Both barb faces are at the print slope: a light, reusable snap
_intent.neck: length of the straight neck from the contact face to the barb; long, so the prongs bend gently
_intent.slot: width of the split that lets the two prongs close; at least 2 x (barb - clearance)
_intent.max_strain: prong root strain limit 3*c*d/L^2 (c: the D-shaped prong's far fibre). Prongs stand along Z, so bending loads layer bonds: PLA inter-layer strength ~20-35 MPa over E ~3 GPa is ~0.007-0.012. Uncalibrated.
_intent.count: pegs per joint when the sites are found automatically: two stop the parts turning

_intent.fit: fit class of the pin in its hole. The profile's press value is a per-side clearance (+0.10 mm), a close slip fit on paper that relies on printed holes coming out undersize
_intent.length: pin length above the contact face
_intent.count: pins per joint when the sites are found automatically

_intent.fit: fit class of the tail sliding in its socket
_intent.width: tail width at the contact face
_intent.depth: tail height from the contact face
_intent.flank_deg: flank angle from vertical; 15 deg is a common dovetail and stays inside the 44 deg print slope
_intent.length: tail length along the slide axis (+Y of the joint frame); the socket runs out past the part in +Y

_intent.fit: fit class of every gap between the two leaves' knuckles
_intent.knuckle_height: straight height of each of the three knuckles
_intent.spine: how far each leaf's spine reaches out from the knuckle axis to meet its part
_intent.swing_deg: rotation either side of the printed position the manifest declares; the gate sweeps it and fails a range the leaves cannot reach
_intent._limit: the cone-stacked knuckles print only with the hinge axis vertical, so the leaves swing in the bed plane like a door; a lid that folds over needs a horizontal axis this geometry cannot print
_intent.bed_relief: how far B's spine steps back at the bed where it faces A's knuckle, so first-layer squish cannot fuse the clearance

_intent.fit: a flexure has no mating gap; its rule is the web thickness
_intent.layer_height: layer height of the profile's slicer process (0.20 mm Standard, printer_profiles.py)
_intent.min_layers: thinnest web: two layers is the least that holds together
_intent.max_layers: thickest web that still flexes; past four layers it is a wall, not a hinge
_intent._strands: strand direction across the hinge line is a slicer setting this check cannot see

_intent.fit: the screw's clearance hole runs from ISO 273 medium to that + 2 x this fit (assembly/gate.py fastener rule)
